_comment: cc-tmux driven-CC hook template (§3.3-3.7). Deploy: merge into the driven CC working dir's .claude/settings.json, and copy cc-posttool.sh + cc-stop-check.sh into .claude/hooks/. All hooks sit on NON-deny paths (PostToolUse/Notification/SessionStart/Stop-block) and degrade silently if a field/matcher name drifts. Smoke the matcher names + $CLAUDE_SESSION_ID availability on the target CC version before relying on them.

hooks.command: d="${CC_OUTPUT_ROOT:-/tmp/cc-output}/${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}"; mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null; in=$(cat); resp=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_response // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ "${#resp}" -gt 4096 ] && printf '%s\n' "$resp" >> "$d/responses-$(date +%s).log" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}"; echo "[cc-tmux] 你是被 cc-tmux 驱动的 CC。session=$s。约定:大输出(>8KB)必须 Write 到 /tmp/cc-output/$s/ 下文件,不要只打进对话(scrollback 会丢)。最近状态:"; tail -3 "/tmp/cc-state-${s}.log" 2>/dev/null || true
